subject: Taxes
title: Tax Morale: The Invisible Engine
description: One-minute skill: Tax Morale: The Invisible Engine.

hook.text: Tax morale is the intrinsic motivation to pay taxes honestly.

buildup.text: High tax morale means people pay even when they could easily cheat.

discovery.text: World Values Survey data shows tax morale is highest in Scandinavia and lowest in parts of Latin America and Africa.

twist.text: Tax morale erodes slowly and recovers even slower. A single corruption scandal can damage compliance for a generation.

climax.text: Tax morale is the engine that makes voluntary systems work. Without it, no amount of enforcement can close the gap.

punchline.text: Can't be measured, drives trillions. Tax morale is the invisible engine.

quiz.question: What is tax morale?
options: The intrinsic motivation to pay taxes honestly
